messages.subject: dartR in R 4.2.1 (June 2022) & RStudio (2022.07.0+548)
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have recently installed a new version of both R (4.2.0 - April 2022) and RStudio (2022.02.3 Build 492), and I had issues with an R package used to import excel files in R (xlsx) (also an important dependency of other R packages), which was making R crash when loaded.

New versions of both R (4.2.1 - June 2022) and RStudio (2022.07.0+548) have been released since then (which hopefully have fixed this issue!), so, I am thinking of updating both R/RStudio to the newest versions...

Would dartR be available on the newest R  (4.2.1 - June 2022) and RStudio (2022.07.0+548) versions, or should I instead install R/RStudio versions previous to the current one I have (mentioned at the beginning of the post)? 

Thanks a lot!
Best,
Gabriella

Hi Gabriella,

You should not have problems installing dartR in the latest versions of R and RStudio. 

Cheers,
Luis
